FIELDS.NAME: Antique Treasures Emporium
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Antique Treasures Emporium, our core operations involve curating and selling a diverse range of antique and collectible items, including furniture, art, and memorabilia. We pride ourselves on providing a carefully maintained climate-controlled environment to protect our merchandise from temperature and humidity fluctuations, essential for preserving the quality and value of these sensitive items. Our inventory is meticulously documented with detailed descriptions, photographs, and current appraisals, particularly for high-value pieces over $10,000, ensuring both our customers and our insurance coverage are robust. Security is paramount; thus, we have installed a monitored alarm system and lockable display cases to mitigate theft risks. Regular inventory audits ensure accuracy in our records and compliance with insurance requirements. We focus on sourcing items with complete provenance documentation to guarantee authenticity, and we employ certified professionals for any restoration work. Operations are conducted from our retail storefront located on Vintage Lane, where we actively engage with customers and collectors alike from our operational hours of 10 AM to 6 PM, Tuesday through Saturday.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On August 10, 2022, a break-in resulted in the theft of several high-value antiques, leading to a loss of $3,000. Another incident on February 15, 2023, involved water damage caused by a burst pipe, damaging inventory valued at $2,000. Both incidents were reported to the authorities, and measures have since been taken to improve security and mitigate future water damage risks. The current status of these claims is pending reimbursement.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: 10 AM to 6 PM, Tuesday through Saturday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Monitored, high-security safe with fire and water resistance, suitable for storing high-value antiques and collectibles.
